On this page

The SDK ​

The reference implementation is the code that reads and writes Mosaic in this repository. It is one correct reading of the standard, not the standard itself.

PackageWhat it is
sdk/ts (mosaic-ts)The core library: archives, packing, federation, selection, composition, glTF and SVG conversion, DuckDB, and the HTTP client and server
sdk/ifc4 (mosaic-ifc4)IFC4 / IFC2X3 conversion, on top of web-ifc
sdk/cli (mosaic)The command line, bundled into a single executable. See The CLI
sdk/ts/src/viewerThe browser viewer, built for both mosaic serve and the static examples

How it follows the standard ​

The SDK doesn't define its own file types. MosaicIndexFile.ts is generated from standard/mosaic-index-file.schema.json with quicktype, and the API client, routes and types in sdk/ts/src/api/ are generated from standard/mosaic-api.openapi3.json. When the standard changes, regenerating them is what carries the change through, and a mismatch shows up as a type error.

The server routes off the generated table of operations, so a test can assert that every operation in the spec has a handler.

What the implementation adds ​

Everything below is built on the standard. A file produced this way is a valid Mosaic file, but another implementation is not required to offer these features:

FeatureNotesDocs
The .tsr archiveA zip with index.json and <type>.ndjson per table, deflated at level 6The format
Source documents.mosaic.json, the index plus component rows in one readable file, packed into an archivePacking
Component namespacescore::, khronos::gltf::, w3c::, ifc4:: and their schemasCore components
CompositionImports followed, sections collapsed, core::inherit expanded, core::child turned into a glTF hierarchyComposing
ConvertersglTF / GLB, IFC and SVG into Mosaic, with stable ids where askedglTF, IFC, SVG
Federation & diffMerging files with shifted references; the changes between two files, by value, as a file of their own (diffArchives, behind mosaic diff)source
SelectionA subset of nodes as a file of its own, made wholesource
DuckDB storageOne table per component type, built from each archive's schemasDuckDB
The serverThe OpenAPI operations over DuckDB, plus the page's own /app/* endpoints, which are not part of the specHTTP API
The viewerTree, components and a 3D view, in the browserExamples

Where it falls short of the standard ​

The standard declares a few things the implementation does not do yet. If you depend on any of these, check the code first:

In the standardIn the reference implementation
ComponentTableReference.type may be PARQUETArchives are read and written as NDJSON only. Parquet is recorded, not read
ImportNode.integrity pins an import by hashStored and carried through, but not verified when an import is resolved
The query operation of the APIAnswers 501 Not Implemented
